scope: Structure (generated and authored parts, classes, aria-hidden scrollbars, no native elements), Base UI's overflow and scrolling data-* and CSS variables from a stubbed viewport, the thumb's track ratio and 4u minimum, the corner, track press and thumb drag, the edge threshold, keep-mounted, of the web component in happy-dom (node:test); the React renderer's server markup (preset equal to the composed parts, keepMounted, className function) and state parity with the web component; resolver numbers. Real layout, scrolling, the fade and RTL are checked in the browser (apps/studio geometry-check.html and react-check.html, the jig); screen-reader output is not certified.

checks.covers: generated and authored anatomy, classes, hidden bars without overflow, overflow and scrolling data-*, the CSS variables, thumb ratio and minimum, corner, track press, thumb drag and release, the edge threshold, keep-mounted
resolveScrollArea: track, inset, thumb, minimum, radii (corner scale), corner
preset markup, ScrollArea.Root / Viewport / Content / Scrollbar / Thumb / Corner equal to the preset, keepMounted and className state, state parity with the web component

limitations: The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
The scrollbars are pointer affordances (aria-hidden), as Base UI's; keyboard and assistive technology scroll the focusable viewport natively.
React measures after mount: its server markup has no overflow state, like the web component before its first measurement.

Manual geometry review (2026-11-03, studio #/components?family=scrolling, light and dark, hovered and scrolled, size ladder u = 3, 4, theme 4.5, 6): 2u tracks at the inline and block ends, the thumb u thick 0.5u inside them with the track ratio (geometry-check scrollArea.* at every SIZES step, both borders, after fixing a rounded clientHeight track: the fractional box is used), the 2u corner only with both bars; growth: the bars follow the area's size and the content grows freely inside the viewport (content min-width fit-content); RTL: the vertical bar moves to the left edge, the horizontal bar starts after the corner and its thumb runs from the right (offset negative), data-overflow-x-start set when scrolled; focus: the viewport takes focus while it overflows, its ring is an outline inset 2px (no size change) inside the area contour, and keyboard focus inside shows the bars; parity: react-check.html twins sa and saY match part by part (place, size, colour, radius, opacity, data-*), fails [].
